topic: Is Bangalore traffic really the worst in India?

hook.text: Is Bangalore traffic really the worst in India?

lines.say: The data says... yes, I'm afraid. In the TomTom Traffic Index twenty twenty-five, Bengaluru is number one in India, and number two in the entire world.
lines.cap: The data says... YES, I'm afraid. TomTom Traffic Index 2025: Bengaluru is #1 in India, and #2 in the entire WORLD.

lines.say: Thirty six minutes to drive ten kilometres! You could finish a whole web series episode in that time!
lines.cap: 36 minutes to drive 10 km! You could finish a whole web series episode in that time!

lines.say: But look on the bright side. That's one hundred and sixty eight hours a year in rush hour. Seven full days of free music time.
lines.cap: But look on the bright side. That's 168 hours a year in rush hour. 7 FULL DAYS of free music time.

lines.say: And Pune, do hold the celebrations, old chap. You're only three points behind.
